proposal.observation: ZN-E010 (AnchoredFade on [h_t, h_t-h_1]): MAPE 0.3325, Acc@15 0.3665, RMSE 425.0 (-20 vs ZN-E005), corr 0.48, gate PASS; >1000-cycle RMSE -75 vs ZN-E005 but bias still -970; 500-1000 bias -533. The fade encoder sees how far a cycle has drifted from cycle 1 but not how fast (drift per cycle), so a cell with large drift late in the prefix and one with the same drift early look alike.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: Adding the per-cycle fade rate r_t = (h_t - h_1)/max(t,1) to the fade-encoder input lets the model separate slow-fading (long-life) from fast-fading (short-life) cells, reducing long-life underprediction: MAPE <= 0.3136 or RMSE <= 424.0 (with MAPE <= 0.3246) or Acc@15 >= 0.4255 vs ZN-E005 under §7.
proposal.question_inherited: Does explicit fade-rate information help the anchored fade encoder on long-life ZN-coin cells?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Whether ZN-E010's remaining long-life bias reflects missing rate (drift per cycle) information.
proposal.why_this_experiment: A2 follow-up 1 of the promising Family 4 (Gemini ZN-E010 analysis); architecture.md §2.2 Anchor / Reference Comparator and §3 'missing temporal trend'; one mechanism (rate term). Gemini's additional zero-init suggestion is deferred to keep one change.
proposal.modification: Degradation encoder input only: u_t = [h_t, h_t - h_1] -> [h_t, h_t - h_1, (h_t - h_1)/max(t,1)], t = 0-based cycle index; first fade Linear 128->64 becomes 192->64 (+4,096 params). Everything else identical to ZN-E010 (T005; default 'anchor' reproduces ZN-E010 exactly).
proposal.held_constant_components: ResConv curve encoder with GELU, fade encoder widths and residual, masked summary, inter_summary, linear GELU readout, d_model 64, dropout 0.1, Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, split 2021, A2-ZN epochs, data.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, split 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps.
proposal.expected_evidence: MAPE/Acc@15/RMSE/DB-MAPE (tools/rescore.py) vs ZN-E005; EOL-band MAPE and bias; pred SD/corr; fade_encoder and readout gradient health; padding sensitivity; params/time.
proposal.rejection_condition: Primary rule (program.md §7, vs active parent ZN-E005 MAPE 0.3216 / RMSE 445.0 / Acc@15 0.4055 / DB-MAPE 0.3216). KEEP iff [A: MAPE <= 0.3136 AND RMSE <= 455.0] OR [B: RMSE <= 424.0 AND MAPE <= 0.3246] OR [C: Acc@15 >= 0.4255 AND MAPE <= 0.3246 AND RMSE <= 455.0], AND Acc@15 >= 0.3755 (A/B) AND DB-MAPE <= 0.3316 AND gradient gate PASS AND prediction SD >= 10% of target SD; otherwise DISCARD. Secondary: change vs ZN-E010 and EOL bands.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput.

architecture_addendum.evidence: ZN-E010 long-life bias -970/-533 with anchor-only input; drift without rate is ambiguous across prefix lengths
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> ResConv [B,100,64] -> u_t=[h_t, d_t, d_t/max(t,1)] [B,100,192] -> Linear 192->64, GELU, Linear 64->64, +h_t -> g_t * mask -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> GELU -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: t from torch.arange over the 100 slots; rate at cycle 1 is 0; g_t multiplied by mask; pooling over mask==1 only. tests/test_anchored_fade.py covers padding invariance and cycle-1 dependence for anchor_rate.
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: MAPE, RMSE, Acc@15, DB-MAPE (= MAPE) vs ZN-E005; EOL bands; gradient gate incl. fade_encoder
